notes.title: Cattle Country: Beneath and Beyond Update
notes.content: [p]Howdy Pardners! We fixin' to serve you sumthin' real good. We've been really putting our backs to it and are finally ready to [b]launch the first Cattle Country content update[/b]. This update will take exploring the Mine to whole new depths while also improving the life on the ranch.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to the Cattle Country community for your continuous feedback and suggestions. Y'all are square shooters in our books.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="zeC9Ri9Xlqo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Full list of new content, fixes and quality of life improvements in the latest game update can be found below.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]MINING RELATED[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Repeatable Town Project – Fire In The Hole. Causes a reset of mine. Unlocks after Jeb’s third heart cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Drill added for faster digging. Unlocks at Mining Level 10. Player will receive a letter about it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Scavenger Anvil added. Breaks down items to reclaim some components. Unlocks at Mining Level 6.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Players have a % chance to encounter Clickable Mine Objects in the mine with loot ranging from mine torches, ladders, platforms, elevators, dynamite to Ores, processed goods, crops, seeds, coins etc.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Mining helmet auto-equips in the mines and swaps back when leaving.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][u][b]MISCELLANEOUS[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Hay Dropper added. Auto-feeds hay for livestock. Unlocks at Farming Level 8.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Scratch Post added. Place in a barn or coop to keep animals happy (simulates player petting the animals). Unlocks at Farming Level 9.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Aquariums added to put your fish in. Small unlocked on Fishing Level 2. Medium unlocked on Fishing Level 5. Large unlocked on Fishing Level 8.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Play a tune to summon your horse. Unlocks once a player has built a stable and obtained your own horse.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Added walleye fish to lakes in spring/fall. It was previously uncatchable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Added letters that inform the player of items they have already unlocked, from this update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Town Hall shows previews of needed donation items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Emily now sells seeds out of season. Player must unlock the greenhouse first.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Maggie sends you a letter if items block house upgrades.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][u][b]GENERAL FIXES AND QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]CRASH FIX[/b] – During Pattie 1 if player finished dialogue while throwing plate on the table the game would require a restart.[/p][/*][*][p][b]CRASH FIX[/b] – The game would crash if you used the mine whistle while climbing a ladder.[/p][/*][*][p][b]CRASH FIX[/b] - Checking the map while Wild Will was inside a building would crash the game, e.g. Pattie 3.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX / NEW CONTENT[/b] – Put egg or turkey egg into crock pot to make mayonnaise.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX / NEW CONTENT[/b] – Add corn to the mill to make cornmeal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX / NEW CONTENT[/b] – Add beets to the mill to make sugar.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Could not complete the boxcar race after year 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Yams took 8 days instead of 11 days like they said they should, switched to 11 days.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Jim 3 cutscene in saloon had duplicate animations / objects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Post office should have been open on Saturdays.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Mayor Archibald now says the correct name of your animal at the end of the livestock fair, if you win.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] - Sometimes the Secret Santa would mess up the people and not work.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – If you gave your Secret Santa a gift before the winter feast, you could not give them a gift during the festival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Player horse colour changing during cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Ho ho ho, if you quit Winter Feast early, Jim would stay in his Santa costume.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] - Winter graphic overlays didn't delete when you removed a piece of equipment in the winter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Crafting buff did nothing, now gives you a 10% chance of making 2 items for the cost of 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] - Fixed the Winter Feast donation box on controller.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Fixed still wearing clothing while riding the horse naked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Added potassium nitrate to the mines. It was previously very difficult to get.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Fixed the general store sale items discount transferring to the buy tab.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – You get a letter the day of the Winter Feast informing you of who your Secret Santa is.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Expanded the capacity of the level 3 and 4 water cans.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Empty water barrels sold at general store during the spring.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Mill take 1 in-game hour to make flour/sugar/cornmeal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Added default recipe for grilled animal meat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Shipping box and chest graphics show open frame when hovering over them with your mouse[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Bank pays out your earned interest into your account on the 1st of every month.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – All seeds available at the general store restock on Mondays after player has built a greenhouse.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 26.6.12
notes.content: [p]Howdy pardners![/p][p][/p][p]In case yall missed it, another patch of fixes and quality of life updates went live over the weekend. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Full list of updates and fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Updated achievement requirements[/b] - Changed the way the Gold Achievement (6) checks to make sure players can achieve it: livestock made easier to win. Previously you required a 5-star "happy" farm animal, otherwise 1/3 chance. This has now been changed to 4-star plus equals guaranteed win[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated moving kit[/b] - You can now use the moving kit on your house when not under construction[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated hunting[/b] - Health of wild animals and damage of players bullets and arrows have been adjusted to make hunting easier[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed pickaxing[/b] - You could pickaxe the fencing of a moving building plot to get back a free version of the building you are moving [/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed quest[/b] - Fixed the Fields ' Glory quest[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed tile selector[/b] - Gray tile selector could not be seen in the winter[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed drawing selector[/b] - Gray drawing selector could not be seen in the winter[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed soft lock issue[/b] - If you entered Tom's heart scene 9 while riding a horse, you would be soft locked in the train cart[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed crash[/b] - Random chance of the game crashing during a stickup[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed routines following marriage -[/b] Sometimes when you married someone they would stop doing their daily routines which was a big problem for store owners.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed rodeo bug[/b] - Sometimes players would get stuck in the air at the rodeo after riding the bull[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed new game bug[/b] - If you were playing a save file and then exited to the main menu and started a new file, two things would happen:[/p][list][*][p]Your spouse would not reset[/p][/*][*][p]Jeb's house state would not reset[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fixed bug[/b] - The scarecrow range bug[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed bug[/b] - Could not get rabbit poo[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed newborn animals[/b] - Newborn chicks and calves would appear in your house on Day 1 of their lives[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed quest requirements[/b] - Newborn calves did not count towards the Raise Four Cows quest[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed town hall donations[/b] - Four crop items were missing visually from the town hall. They would not show up after donating.[/p][/*][*][p]Townsfolk now have icons on the map screen to ease the tracking of NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Players are no longer able to give non-town NPC gifts[/p][/*][*][p]Right click or press X on controller to change the name/colour of your horse[/p][/*][*][p]Train boxes no longer turn invisible if you steal from them[/p][/*][*][p]Added poo to hares[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 25.6.3
notes.content:
Boy howdy, another one?!

The work hasn't slowed down in the workshop and here's another set of them fixes and updates for ye.

To our players on the other platforms, we appreciate the frustrations around PC patches going live while waiting on consoles to catch up but we want to reassure you that we are working as fast as we can to get all the platforms synced up and apologise that there are still issues on consoles. The reason consoles are dragging behind is the lengthier submissions processes compared to PC, varying from 2 days to 2 weeks, while Steam allows developers to publish patches whenever they are ready.

[h3]Full list of fixes and updates[/h3]

[list]
[*][b] Fixed glitch[/b] - Slide stuck on the left side of the town map
[*][b] Fixed furnace[/b] - If you put less than 5 sand in a furnace, on the "requires 5" ticker message it showed a picture of clay
[*][b] Butcher resource glitch[/b] - If you took your animals to the butcher and then closed the game before picking them up, when you next visited the butcher to pick up your resources there wouldn't be any
[*][b] Fixed inventory discard[/b] - Sometimes you wouldn't be able to delete inventory items. Nothing would happen when you clicked the trash
[*][b] Fixed the 24 hour clock (for real)[/b] - The time would still show 24:00 at midnight instead of 0:00
[*][b]Fixed resource rewards from butchering[/b] - Butchering calves and chicks for ridiculous amount of resources is no longer possible
[*][b]Fixed animals restrictions in barns and coops[/b] - Players would be able to have more than 6 animals in their barn or coop if babies were born on the same day
[*][b]Fixed chick growth[/b] - Baby chicks no longer exclusively turn into white chickens
[*][b]Fixed calves growth[/b] - Baby calves no longer exclusively turn into white cows
[*][b]Fixed localisation issue[/b] - Resource names when butchering an animal weren't translating
[*][b]Fixed equipment pickups[/b] - If you had equipment on a carpet, there was a 50/50 chance you couldn't put anything in the equipment
[*][b]Fixed villager pause menu[/b] -  If you gave someone a present and you only had 1, the gift icon would not show up on the villagers pause menu
[*] Hold down right mouse button, or X on the controller, to take/move more than 1 on menus
[*] Worms won't spawn on tiled soil, making them untillable
[*] Removed Jane's "Kill 10 bandits" quest if the player has enemies turned off
[*] Stopped mushrooms from growing on trees with sappers
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 25.6.1
notes.content:
Howdy, Cowpokes!

A whole week of cozy life in the Wild West is already behind us. Hope yer tending them crops and feeding them chickens. Maybe there's even already some romance up in the air? We've been keeping our sleeves rolled up and hands dirty too and have another patch update to share with yous right now!


[h3]FULL LIST OF FIXES AND UPDATES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved player walk and horse speed[/b] - Both the player character and their horse now traverse the wilderness a little bit quicker.
[*] [b]Fixed game crash when hoeing out of bounds[/b] - The game would crash if the player used the upgraded hoe to hoe outside of the bounds of the map
[*] [b]Fixed rodeo crash[/b] - Rodeo suffered from the same crash as the Hoedown event where the game crashed if you spoke to someone after the event.
[*] [b]Fixed inventory crash[/b] - The game would crash if players held shift while pressing to reorganize their chest or inventory.
[*] [b]Fixed menu closure issues[/b] - Menu would randomly stop closing using P or ESD.
[*] [b]Fixed building duplication bug[/b] - Buildings no longer duplicate randomly when attempting to move them around.
[*] [b]Fixed relationship advancement[/b] - It previously took 2 heart levels worth of gifts to get to level 2 heart after auto-gaining level 1 from introductions. This is no longer the case.
[*] [b]Fixed R key and key reconfiguration[/b] - The R key is no longer used for both rotating chairs/sofas and changing rows in your inventory at the bottom of the HUD. Use keys Q and E to change rows in your inventory.
[*] [b]Fixed Maggie quest dialogue and controller issue[/b] - Maggie 3 hearts scene used to say craft 10 items in dialogue and description instead of 50. The scene also didn't work on controllers.
[*] [b]Fixed item duplication[/b] - If you had an item on the mouse when you close any menu, the item amount would be doubled and put back in your inventory
[*] [b]Fixed wine rack[/b] - When removing items from wine rack, using mouse, you could get anywhere from 1-14 bottles back
[*] [b]Fixed gin icon[/b] - Gin showed the wrong icon on the distiller pop-up
[*] [b]Fixed inventory chest stacking issue[/b] - Sometimes items in your inventory chest would become unstackable, two of the same item with the same quality could not be combined
[*] [b]Fixed unlimited bull riding gifts[/b] - The player could get unlimited bull riding gifts. 
[*] [b]Fixed bull achievement requirements[/b] - Ride the bull achievement was set to 60 seconds to obtain but the description says 30 seconds. The requirement has been changed to 30 seconds.
[*] [b]Fixed achievement bug[/b] - The mayor's gifts for donating were not working properly, causing players to be unable to complete the achievement.
[*] [b]Fixed tool upgrading[/b] - If you upgraded a tool, pickaxe for example, and had a lower quality pickaxe in your inventory, it would combine tools and override to the lower one
[*] [b]Fixed chocolate bar cooking cost[/b] - Chocolate bars had no cooking costs and could be made for free and sold for 220g.
[*] [b]Fixed glass making[/b] - Players couldn't make glass in the furnace (5 sand + 1 coal).
[*] [b]Fixed tree seeds[/b] - Tree seeds no longer result in the wrong tree type, for example apple tree seeds turning into lemon trees.
[*] [b]Fixed 24hr clock[/b] - Midnight is now shown as 0:00 instead of 24:00.
[*] Added range overlay to scarecrows and sprinklers.
[*] Gain a speed buff once a day from using the outhouse.
[*] Number of birds per map have been reduced.
[*] Store open hours added - Click on the store doors to see their opening hours (when closed).
[*] Building tooltips added to the pause map
[*] Sight line added for guns when using a controller
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 25.5.28
notes.content:
Howdy pardners!

Hope you are enjoying your cozy Wild West life so far! We been busy gathering your feedback, replicating bugs and figuring out them fixes for ya. And lo' and behold, we have the first post-launch patch live [b]RIGHT NOW[/b], addressing some issues flagged by the community.

[h3][b]Full list of fixes in this patch[/b]:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed localisation bug - The game no longer stops player from progressing after reaching farming level 3 when playing with the Japanese language.

This same patch update will be coming to Xbox this week and PS5 and Nintendo Switch in the next week or so.

notes.title: New Cattle Country Demo for Next Fest!
notes.content:
Howdy folks!

It's demo season round these parts as Steam Next Fest rolls into town again with new wares to peddle and Cattle Country is no different!

We're back with a new version of the Cattle Country demo, bringing some new additions, tweaks and fixes. So whether you've been round here before or you're new, let's see what awaits you in this new frontier, eh?

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h2]Horses![/h2]

That's right, ride into town, or out into the sticks with your own trusty steed! As part of the demo, you've been given a stable right out the gate, so make use of your new companion to get around. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/41695e0cb48601a06adff553827e189d5b7a3024.gif[/img]

[h2]Contact from an old friend...[/h2]

While you've got the townsfolk of Hill Valley to befriend, it's nice to hear from an old acquaintance every once in a while huh? In this new demo, expect to receive a letter from a certain someone with well wishes...

[h1]What else to expect?[/h1]

[list]
[*] This demo builds upon previous Betas with new additions and tweaks
[*] Prairie pets for your farm!
[*] Expanded mining gameplay
[*] Character customisation! - Customise your outfit, hair, prefixes and more!
[*] Mayor Archibald is on hand at the edge of your farm for game assistance and directions!
[*] Meet the Welcoming Committee - Key townsfolk with advice or tasks for you
[*] Explore the mines, hone your fishing skills, craft items, tend to crops, decorate your homestead and more!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=NE27AT6YDwc;full][/previewyoutube]

While we're still actively developing the game, more feedback is always welcome! You can fill out [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSebOT50GwfkPOv3MeivU7YQm214iUJEV4ujyV1M1ppbOhgmLg/viewform]this feedback form[/url] or [url=http://discord.gg/PJnxtDVMeW]join our friendly Discord community![/url]

So what're you waitin' for? Come on down to Hill Valley and give the slow life a try!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country/

notes.title: Mining preview: What's mined is yours!
notes.content:
Howdy folks!

As we continue to develop Cattle Country into the coziest, cowboy-iest farming/life-sim, we wanted to share some more details about an element of the game we think you'll love, mining!

[h3]What's mined is yours![/h3]

Ready to dig deep and make some serious cash? The mines in Hill Valley are a great place to gather resources. When you grab your pickaxe and head underground, the world changes. What starts as a top-down view of the wild frontier shifts to a side-on perspective, plunging you into the depths and giving your a new perspective on your dark surroundings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/6a8285962a2eb9f3ff07e3717e8ab9174f95c574.gif[/img]

When you arrive in Hill Valley, Jeb will be on hand to show you how to use dynamite, and get the most out of your underground adventures, so take his advice! It may be the difference between vast riches, getting lost or even worse, waking up at the Doctors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/ca2106be52b692c3dc3f56fae7e40376de4e3db0.gif[/img]

In the final game, mining will be a great way to explore and gather materials for crafting and other treasures but with the chance of reward also comes risk! We've now added a variety of enemies into the mines to watch out for on your descent! Look out for rats, spiders and even flying critters! You might wanna make use of the weapons at your disposal to ensure you can safely traverse the depths. 

We'll be sharing more elements of life in Cattle Country over the coming months, so hit the Wishlist button to stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country/

notes.title: Cattle Country Closed Beta - What To Expect!
notes.content:
Howdy, folks (I'm never gonna get bored of starting these with "Howdy")

We're rollin' on up on Beta time and wanted to give y'all a quick nudge to [b]check your emails if you signed up to take part in the Closed Beta[/b], we still have a number of folks who haven't responded to us and we need to ensure you're ready to take part! 

[h2]What can you expect from the Beta?[/h2]

The Closed Beta will feature a small slice of what you can expect from the full Cattle Country experience. The game is still in early development so this Beta will not represent the final scope or performance of the final product! 

You'll be able to create your character, manage your ranch, interact with a few local characters, and explore the early features of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/8e8d9434d613c66b58d54855cb6fd43222d95b88.png[/img]

You'll start by customizing your character, and naming your ranch, as well as meeting Mayor Archibald who will welcome you to the town, for the sake of saving a little time, he's even set up a small simple ranch to get you started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/39b8e1b920f6ed8f61a4311b40309067a3bfb71f.png[/img]

Mayor Archibald will then stay near by the ranch, ready to whisk you away to the Town Square or the Mines if you want to fast travel. However, if you would prefer to explore on foot there will be signposts dotted about to help you on your way!

You'll also be able to interact with, and befriend, a small handful of the characters planned for the full game who will have a variety of quests for you to potentially help with! These lovely folk are known as the Welcoming Committee; with Carl the bank teller, Sassy the outdoor expert, John the blacksmith, and Carrie who owns the saloon which... rumours have it might be haunted??

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/34d397ddea836d7e7b4c4660e297ea6e6082f9b2.png[/img]

This Beta is a chance to provide feedback. If you're invited to the Beta, you'll receive a feedback form, access to a Steam Discussion forum and a Discord space for your thoughts.
 
Don’t worry if you didn't manage to get into this round of Beta Testing — there will be more opportunities to play Cattle Country down the road!
 
We're lookin' forward to welcoming you to this little community of settlers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country/
